rv.q: "Seven Guitars" by City Lit Theater continues the company’s track record of capably curating and producing great literary works.
It's a decent portrayal of Black life in America
City Lit Theatre is observing the 30th anniversary of "Seven Guitars" with a very powerful and satisfying production.
All that being said, it is Robert Howard’s winning performance in the role of Hedley that makes today’s production so memorable and why I recommend it so highly.

cn.t: City Lit's production of August Wilson's "Seven Guitars" earns strong reviews for skillful direction and authentic performances that capture the play's blues rhythms and poignant exploration of Black life in 1940s Pittsburgh.
